## Featured Open-Source Repositories

- [KeplerBridge](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/KeplerBridge): Experimental C++20 Direct3D 12-to-Direct3D 11 compatibility layer for legacy NVIDIA Kepler GPUs with bounded DXIL-to-DXBC translation (v0.5.0-rc1).
- [AgentForge](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/AgentForge): Local-first TypeScript and Node.js AI agent integration and workflow harness with MCP connectivity, permission-gated execution, and approval checkpoints.
- [Notion Block Engine](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/notion-block-engine): Zero-dependency TypeScript library for bidirectional parsing, sanitization, and conversion across Markdown, HTML, clipboard data, and Notion-style Block ASTs.
- [VYDRIX](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/VYDRIX): Archived C#/.NET Windows cloud-backed virtual storage experiment using WinFsp, preserved with a public technical post-mortem.
